summary_en: 700,000 shares (3.1% of S/O), ¥1.0B ceiling. Open-market purchase Aug 10–Sep 30, 2026. Rationale: optimal capital structure and shareholder return under Challenge 2027 medium-term plan (FY2025–27).
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Carlit Co., Ltd. announced on 6 August 2026 a buyback authorization approved by the board that day. The company will acquire up to 700,000 ordinary shares (3.1% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum consideration of ¥1.0 billion via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from 10 August through 30 September 2026. The stated purpose is to implement shareholder returns aligned with optimal capital structure and capital-efficiency targets outlined in the "Challenge 2027" medium-term plan (FY2025–27).
